requirements_summary: Customer is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for a production-grade LLM platform where all model I/O and telemetry must meet enterprise encryption controls. Key asks: mutual TLS for all north-south and service-to-service traffic (mTLS with client certs and short-lived cert rotation), enforcement of TLS 1.3 only, support for customer-managed keys (CMKs) backed by HSM (FIPS 140-2/3), envelope encryption for object and block stores (S3/EBS) using customer CMKs, database encryption at rest (AES-256-GCM), and documented key rotation procedures. They require KMS auditability: ability to produce KMS usage logs for key usage within 48 hours and integration with their SIEM (Splunk). Secrets management must integrate with HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager and support automatic dynamic secrets for DB credentials. Customer requires documented procedures for CMK creation, rotation cadence (recommended 90 days, customer may require 30/60), and emergency key rotation/rotations-of-keys-without-downtime. Networking: ExpressRoute/Direct Connect + private endpoints (no public IPs), IP allowlists, and optional on-prem connector. Data residency: separate EU/US VPCs with no cross-region replication for regulated datasets. Audit logging: immutable audit trail retention policy up to 7 years, tamper-evident logs, and daily export to customer SIEM. Compliance: SOC 2 + ISO 27001 evidence required; preference for HSM-backed KMS and signed attestation for crypto operations. Quote from CISO: "We need provable key ownership and the ability to revoke keys and show usage history in a forensics window."
notes: Shorthand from calls — prefers HSM CMKs, hates single-tenant VM options without HSM keys. Wants Redwood to show key rotation demo with zero downtime.
